verdict.rationale: No documented bulk-operations feature exists, but a few indirect paths approximate it. Workspace-level skills apply across every project (lovable-docs-39). The SQL editor gives direct database access that could run set-based changes (lovable-docs-6). The Lovable MCP server lets an external AI agent create projects, send messages and deploy apps, so multi-project actions could be scripted (lovable-docs-37). Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-action capability (e.g., multi-select edits or batch operations across projects or records), documentation of batch workflows, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
